en: Black‑and‑white street scene with an early electric tram marked with the route sign "Borna" and the number 29, running along a tree‑lined avenue. People in early 20th‑century European clothing walk on a wide sidewalk beside iron railings. To the left is a multi‑story building with partly visible signage indicating a restaurant, and a small kiosk on the sidewalk. In the background are factory chimneys and substantial masonry buildings, giving an urban, slightly industrial impression.
